Hemenway Trust Company Lowered Stake in Ipg Photonics (IPGP) as Share Price Rose; Chevron (CVX) Shareholder Viking Fund Management Cut Stake by $1.50 Million
May 2, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Viking Fund Management Llc decreased its stake in Chevron Corp (CVX) by 34.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Viking Fund Management Llc sold 12,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.26% with the market. The institutional investor held 22,650 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.84M, down from 34,650 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Viking Fund Management Llc who had been investing in Chevron Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $241.16B market cap company. The stock increased 1.07% or $1.34 during the last trading session, reaching $126.2. About 2.68 million shares traded. Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX) has risen 7.88% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.67% the S&P500.
Hemenway Trust Company Llc decreased its stake in Ipg Photonics (IPGP) by 17.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hemenway Trust Company Llc sold 8,605 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.81% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 41,463 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.88 million, down from 50,068 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hemenway Trust Company Llc who had been investing in Ipg Photonics for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.12 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.31% or $7.72 during the last trading session, reaching $225.57. About 304,455 shares traded. IPG Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:IPGP) has risen 93.68% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 82.13% the S&P500.
Hemenway Trust Company Llc, which manages about $524.98 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Unilever Plc New Adr (NYSE:UL) by 10,955 shares to 196,148 shares, valued at $10.86M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
